Day 6 · Torres del Paine & Milodón Cave — Full-Day Shared Tour At 7:00 a.m., you will be picked up from your hotel and depart for the Milodón Cave Natural Monument, where a prehistoric mammal lived approximately 12,000 years ago. We will then continue the tour, enjoying incredible views of Soffa Lagoon, Cordillera Prat, Lago Porteño, Cerro Mesa, and Toro Lake. We will make a stop at Grey Viewpoint, followed by a visit to the village of Río Serrano.

The tour continues with a hike around Grey Lake, passing through a lenga forest to reach the lakeshore, where you may see icebergs that have broken away from the glacier. Lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, visit the viewpoints overlooking Pehoé Lake and Salto Grande, followed by a pleasant walk to the 18-meter-high waterfall. The tour continues with visits to viewpoints overlooking Nordenskjöld Lake, Laguna Amarga, and Sarmiento Lake.

Return to Puerto Natales, arriving at approximately 6:45 p.m.
